cases.feature: Exact owner-bound Save classification
cases.observed: Policy regression passes locally and in candidate platform image. Live read-only policy evaluation reports R1/write_internal/autonomous. Explicit stricter company overrides remain effective; unbound submit stays R3.
cases.recommendation: Do not infer a successful business Save from policy acceptance alone.

cases.feature: Owner self-service native Save setup
cases.observed: Owner console saved exact Customer, Note and Opportunity bindings for loopback website only. No public domain bindings were changed.
cases.recommendation: Keep IDs, route, visible control label and effect family reviewed for each host.

cases.feature: Reusable saved workflow group
cases.observed: Published manual-only 10-node workflow uses one saved local website group. A replacement panel linked to that same group without modifying group IDs in the definition.
cases.recommendation: Future user panels must explicitly link to this existing group; offline panels receive no commands.

cases.feature: Workflow Customer → Note → Opportunity saved end to end
cases.observed: Run 4064 completed inspection and Customer fill, then failed at Save Customer with COPILOT_POLICY_BLOCKED. Zero host saves observed; Note and Opportunity were not reached.
cases.recommendation: Fresh full run and independent host record readback remain required. Replacement fill-use approval is pending.

cases.feature: Live Save execution after classification correction
cases.observed: The policy mismatch is fixed and unit/live policy preview pass. No successful live Save run has yet validated the correction.
cases.recommendation: Use the approved synthetic local workflow after the requested replacement grant approval; verify three exact persisted records independently.

cases.feature: Temporary UAT grant cleanup
cases.observed: Original run consumed 1/3 fill uses. Existing owner-scoped cleanup function removed that exact temporary workflow override after UI control timed out; independent readback confirmed zero remaining overrides for the workflow.
cases.recommendation: Issue no replacement grant until the pending approval arrives; preserve company policies.
